scope: Recovered result of an earlier read-only native job whose orchestration call timed out. It lists clipboard formats only; no clipboard payload was read. The current format observation is not the user's earlier text-paste baseline and does not measure image/text payload retrieval or durable storage.
limitations: A 1.15 ms successful format query in this sample does not establish the cause of the original reported delay.
Orchestration timeout was not treated as native job failure and the probe was not replayed.
